analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (90,450 KRW) vs SMA5 (94,059 KRW) / SMA20 (105,749 KRW) / SMA50 (105,892 KRW): Below short/mid-term trends, diagnosing a weak phase.
· Position relative to SMA100 (115,119 KRW) / SMA200 (99,309 KRW): Confirming weakening long-term trend.
· 52-week position (38.1%) + Current price range near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (43.5→30.2): Entering oversold territory, strengthening downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-327.0548→-2477.5642): Weakness expanding, dead cross maintained.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band 90,698 KRW): Approaching lower band, potential for further decline.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support line (82,500 KRW): Close to Pivot S1 (79,103 KRW), support expected on further decline.
· Swing resistance line (95,680 KRW): Below Pivot R1 (108,363 KRW), resistance zone on short-term bounces.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Lower High forming): Confirming continuation of downtrend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.90x): Volume contraction, decreasing confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Downtrend): Wait-and-see conditions with potential for further downside.
